records.translation: 你把這裡打理得很好。#$b#看得出來你已經盡力了……我只求這一點。我以你為榮。

records.source: You've done well, my boy.^You've done well, my dear.#$b#%farm Farm has never looked better. It's an honor to the family name.#$b#Grandpa is pleased.
records.translation: 你做得很好，我的孩子。^你做得很好，親愛的孩子。#$b#%farm農場從未如此繁榮。你為家族增添了榮耀。#$b#爺爺很欣慰。

records.source: Um, excuse me.#$b#I have a gift for you. I found it last summer when I was playing at the beach. I hope you like it.$h
records.translation: 嗯，不好意思。#$b#我有一份禮物要送給你。去年夏天我在海灘玩時發現的。希望你會喜歡。$h

records.source: I'm glad you moved here, farmer @!$h
records.translation: 很高興你搬來這裡，農夫@！$h

records.source: Hey, @. I'm your secret gift-giver this year.#$b#Here, open it.$h

records.source: It's not much, but I hope you like it.$h
